descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S01 「医院走一遍界面：手动添加、重复时保留、打开病历、床旁完成、任务完成和删除、移除病人——每一行都写进去」 Hospital walk through the screens: manual add, duplicate kept, chart opened, encounter completed, task completed and deleted, patient removed — every row lands

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Adding a patient by scan and by manual entry is logged, each add tagged by method (scan vs manual), in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT OAT-06 Test 1；UAT 3.3；TFA-94514 AC 1；TFA-92580 AC 7；TFA-92580 Analytics）
  • U2 Removing / discharging a patient is logged, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT OAT-06 Test 2；UAT 3.3；TFA-94514 AC 1；TFA-92580 AC 7；TFA-92580 Analytics）
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts)（UAT OAT-06 Test 3；UAT 3.3；TFA-94514 AC 1；TFA-92580 AC 7；TFA-92580 AC 5）
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day（UAT OAT-06 Test 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-94514 AC 4）
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately)（UAT OAT-06 Test 7；UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1；UAT TC-24；TFA-94514 AC 2）
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del …（UAT 3.6；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician (make-session) whose Hospital patient is seeded with status note-ready, a short finished note and two open tasks; run start time T0 recorded so fixture rows are ignored

When Add 'QA Hosp OAT06 Manual' with the add form; add the same name and room again and answer Cancel to the duplicate question; open {hospitalPatient}'s chart on Pre-Round; on Post-Round tap Complete on task 1 and Delete on task 2, then Mark Encounter Complete; …

Then Since T0: patientActivityEvents has patient_added (hospital, addMethod manual) x1, duplicate_prompt_shown + duplicate_prompt_accepted sharing one promptId (addMethod manual), patient_removed (hospital, removalReason manual) x1. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-06 Test 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and TFA-94514 AC 1/2/4. Post-run backend read (patientActivity:_recentForActor, usage:_recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor for the physician's local day, filtered on _creationTime >= T0): the exact counts in 'then'; serialised rows mustNotContain both patient names, '4B-61', 'Cellulitis', 'recheck BMP', 'call PT'. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
